      - text: DISCRETE AND APPLIED MATHEMATICS
      - heading "Present Value" [level=1]
      - paragraph: Discount future cash flows.
      - text: "Level: Intermediate-Advanced Lab: Applied Modelling Lab Duration: 6-10 min"
      - paragraph:
        - strong: "Objective:"
        - text: Understand and compute the present value of a future cash flow using discounting.
      - navigation:
        - button "◇ Interact Manipulate & explore"
        - button "◇ Learn Key ideas"
        - button "◇ Worked Example See it solved"
        - button "◇ Formula The rule"
        - button "◇ Practice Try it yourself"
      - heading "1. OBSERVE & MANIPULATE" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Use the controls to move backward in time and find the present value.
      - button "Reset":
        - img
        - text: Reset
      - main:
        - text: Timeline (years)
        - strong: Future cash flow (FV)
        - text: 0 1 2 3 4 5 ← ← ← ← ←
        - status: Present Value (PV) ₹17,824.65
        - status: ₹25,000.00
        - heading "Discounting step-by-step (at r = 7%, n = 5)" [level=3]
        - paragraph: "Year 5 → 4: 25,000.00 ÷ 1.07 = 23,364.49"
        - paragraph: "Year 4 → 3: 23,364.49 ÷ 1.07 = 21,835.97"
        - paragraph: "Year 3 → 2: 21,835.97 ÷ 1.07 = 20,407.45"
        - paragraph: "Year 2 → 1: 20,407.45 ÷ 1.07 = 19,072.38"
        - paragraph: "Year 1 → 0: 19,072.38 ÷ 1.07 = 17,824.65"
        - term: PRESENT VALUE (PV)
        - definition: ₹17,824.65
        - text: Today’s value
        - term: DISCOUNT
        - definition: ₹7,175.35
        - text: Amount of discount
        - term: "% DISCOUNT"
        - definition: 28.70%
        - text: of future cash flow
      - complementary:
        - heading "Controls" [level=2]
        - text: Future cash flow (FV) Amount received in the future.
        - slider "Future cash flow (FV) slider": "25000"
        - emphasis: 100 100000
        - text: ₹
        - spinbutton "Future cash flow (FV)": "25000"
        - text: Interest rate (r) Annual discount rate.
        - slider "Interest rate (r) slider": "7"
        - emphasis: 0 25
        - spinbutton "Interest rate (r)": "7"
        - text: "% Years (n) Number of years to the future."
        - slider "Years (n) slider": "5"
        - emphasis: 1 20
        - spinbutton "Years (n)": "5"
        - text: years
        - heading "Formula in use" [level=3]
        - strong:
          - text: PV = FV / (1+r)
          - superscript: "n"
        - paragraph: What present value is shown?
        - text: ₹17,824.65
      - article:
        - heading "2. NOTICE THE PATTERN" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Higher rate or more years reduces present value.
        - paragraph: ➜ Increase r → PV decreases
        - paragraph: ➜ Increase n → PV decreases
        - paragraph: ➜ Increase FV → PV increases
      - article:
        - heading "3. UNDERSTAND THE RULE" [level=3]
        - paragraph: We discount future money back to today’s value.
        - strong:
          - text: PV = FV / (1+r)
          - superscript: "n"
        - paragraph: PV = today, FV = future, r = rate per year, n = years.
      - article:
        - heading "4. WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Find the present value.
        - text: FV = ₹25,000, r = 7%, n = 5
        - paragraph:
          - text: PV = 25,000/(1.07)
          - superscript: "5"
          - text: PV = ₹17,824.65
        - text: Correct ✓
      - article:
        - heading "5. MISCONCEPTION CHECK" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Don’t subtract or multiply the rate and years.
        - paragraph: "Incorrect: 25,000 - (7% × 5)"
        - paragraph:
          - text: "Correct: Use PV = FV/(1+r)"
          - superscript: "n"
      - heading "6. TRY INDEPENDENTLY (QUICK CHALLENGE)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Find the present value.
      - text: ₹ 10,000 8 % 3 years Your answer
